text:
Added an independent saved-artifact verifier covering event/counter/objective continuity, capture-record identity, explicit rejection state, raw array dimensions/hashes and bit-identical final checkpoint versus ordinary final export. Its source was sealed before the first fit completed. A read-only interim check finds both coarse-end exported maps byte-identical to the completed P01 control, as expected for the historical selected trajectory with zero accepted fine updates; the actual final replay gate is still pending.

Analyzed existing historical per-structure reports without new fits or runtime selection. step-scaled-fine1.5 versus selected control: OASIS 11-to-12 loses bidirectional Dice in 45/62 structures, with 33/62 higher HD95; mean Dice change -0.0093617474, median-label HD95 change +0.1573833928 mm. OASIS 13-to-14 has 29/62 Dice losses and +0.0005835253 mean change; MMRR 11-to-12 has 32/62 Dice losses, mean +0.0020963990 but median-label HD95 worsens +0.1112163890 mm. All 62 structures, both directions, counts and input hashes are retained in historical-regions-v1.json. The worst OASIS 11-to-12 Dice changes include medial orbitofrontal, parahippocampal and lingual regions; label names were verified against the official FreeSurfer LUT and recorded with source URL/hash. These observed associations do not establish a mechanism or qualify a policy.
